settle-the-chainpoint-contract.text: First record the remaining rulings and build a small model with an independently reviewed contract and playable simulation. Cryptographic assumptions must stay explicit.

specify-the-trust-and-availability-offer.text: Specify both own-anchor and institutional-publication choices, keeping root acceptance separate from purchased data capacity. Define availability commitments, compatible evidence, sessions and explicit coverage failures. Resolve rollback before promising session behavior. Discovery, billing and remedies remain integration choices.

measure-the-ledger-engine.text: Start with the linked CSMT-UTXO engine, benchmark paths and metrics. Measure anchor validation and current commitment costs separately from archive storage, retained views and query or proof serving. Bind results to the actual workload and configuration.

demonstrate-one-complete-journey.text: Verify an NFT state and application proof at a pinned chainpoint before transaction construction. Exercise altered data, missing history, rollback and expiry. Switch between two compatible providers without changing anchor policy, and refuse incompatible coverage or root substitution. Test both local roots and explicitly identified test institutional publishers.

assign-implementation-work.text: Reconcile the older CSMT milestones with the accepted project contracts. Keep project decisions here and implementation acceptance in the component repositories.

delivery-status.text: This bootstrap creates a design record and documentation checks only. Existing paused implementation work remains paused; no production service or product release is launched.
